name: 锥体(路堤/基坑)土方计算器

map.由底面积与高求锥体体积: Pyramid Volume from Base Area and Height
map.输入底面积 A 与高 h，求锥体体积。: Enter base area A and height h to obtain the pyramid volume.
map.📖 查看「由底面积与高求锥体体积 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Pyramid Volume from Base Area and Height User Guide"
map.堆体（锥/棱锥）体积估 1/3 底面积×高。: Estimate the volume of a heap (cone/pyramid) as 1/3 × base area × height.
map.底面积 100 m²、高 9m → V=1/3×100×9=300 m³；土堆/: Base area 100 m², height 9 m → V = 1/3×100×9 = 300 m³; quick estimate for soil piles / fill.
map.同底高柱体 900 m³，锥仅 1/3，堆体勿按柱算否则高估 3 倍。: A prism of same base and height is 900 m³; the pyramid is only 1/3, so do not compute a heap as a prism or you overestimate 3×.
map.V=1/3×底面积×高，与圆锥同形（圆锥是圆底棱锥极限）。: V = 1/3 × base area × height, same shape as a cone (a cone is the limit of a circular-base pyramid).
map.自然堆体/锥形开挖，规则基坑用棱柱/棱镜体更准。: Natural heaps / conical excavation; regular excavations use prisms / prismoidal for better accuracy.
